paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan, brother of Mar son of Ravina.
Mentioned in Shabbat 94a, where he raised a difficulty to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak.[^1][^2]

notes.text: צד. gives the source Shabbat 94a locator by convention, whereas the matching William Davidson vocalized episode is at 94b. That passage explicitly names Rabbi Yochanan and Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak, supporting these exact title expansions and question direction.

The named passage has דמר בריה דרבנא, against supplied דרבינא. The source retains Ravina; neither Hebrew layer is silently changed. Mar’s son-of relation stays attached to Mar rather than being shifted onto Yochanan. The source does not adjudicate the origin of the locator or name difference.
